candidates.change_summary: Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so prior deposits are overwritten instead of accumulated.
Replace the clamp expression with `_unlockTime` so a past unlock time can be stored, allowing immediate withdrawal via Collect.
Swap the ternary branches to `_unlockTime>block.timestamp?block.timestamp:_unlockTime` so a past unlock time stays in the past.
Delete the `acc.balance += msg.value;` statement so deposits are never credited.
Delete the `acc.unlockTime = ...` statement so the unlock time is never updated.
Delete the statement that deducts _am from acc.balance, so a successful Collect no longer reduces the stored balance.
Replace the unlockTime guard with true, allowing Collect to withdraw before the unlock time has passed.
Replace the MinSum guard with true, allowing Collect to withdraw even when the balance is below MinSum.
Change the failure branch of the send check so that a failed low-level call no longer reverts, leaving the balance deducted without the ether being sent.
Replace the balance accumulation `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so previous deposits are overwritten instead of added.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so deposits are never credited to the holder's balance.
Invert the conditional so unlockTime is set to block.timestamp when _unlockTime is later, and to _unlockTime otherwise.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;`, dropping the max with block.timestamp.
Delete the balance-decrement statement so the caller's stored balance is never reduced after a successful withdrawal.
Invert the success check so the call reverts on a successful transfer and logs on a failed one.
